why: Criterion 1 of Issue #222 requires before/after frames on a crowd scene (nine bodies, starting map, battle) as the proof, not a code citation. Round 1's PR body substituted a code location ("Named in legend[2]") for this; independent review returned the PR for exactly that (finding 1). This file supplies the frames and the commands that produced them.

scene.sameSceneAs: evidence/210-before.json ("On the frame nine bodies stand together"), reused unchanged so this frame is directly comparable to the one Issue #210's readable-blow work already measured.

before.commitDescription: origin/main HEAD before any commit of PR #232 (the state dot and raider dot are drawn, undocumented in the legend — the state Issue #222 was opened against)
before.worktree: C:/gamedev/_wt-222-before (git worktree add C:/gamedev/_wt-222-before 5b82944, read-only, removed after capture)
before.captureCommand: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run-game.ps1 -GodotPath <godot-console> -Fixture prepared -ScreenshotTicks 1318 -ScreenshotPath "222/before.png" -TileSize 40 -CameraZoom 2.0 -CameraPosition "1020,480" -UiScale 1.0 -FrameSize "1280x720" -TemporaryRoot <short dir outside the worktree>
before.result: exitCode 0, engineErrorCount 0, checksum 81ea5502d82ad300404b0fdc56a5ebf4cee8562996068f965771016b8e83fb12 (matches evidence/210-before.json's frameBefore.checksum exactly, confirming the same deterministic scene)
before.legendNote: 8 rows: LEGEND heading (9pt) plus 7 content rows. Neither the state dot nor the raider dot has a legend row at this commit.

after.commitDescription: this round's tip: state-dot legend row added, raider dot removed (decision recorded at the DrawRaiderInformation call site), legend restructured back to 8 rows to keep AssertLabelsFit green
after.captureCommand: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run-game.ps1 -GodotPath <godot-console> -Fixture prepared -ScreenshotTicks 1318 -ScreenshotPath "222/after.png" -TileSize 40 -CameraZoom 2.0 -CameraPosition "1020,480" -UiScale 1.0 -FrameSize "1280x720" -TemporaryRoot <short dir outside the worktree>
after.result: exitCode 0, engineErrorCount 0, checksum 81ea5502d82ad300404b0fdc56a5ebf4cee8562996068f965771016b8e83fb12 (identical scene checksum to before -- only the HUD differs, never the simulated world)
after.legendNote: 8 rows: legend[0] = "LEGEND — amber X = dig mark / yellow bar = dig progress" (heading folded into the shortest content row), legend[2] = "dot: blue=idle amber=fighting pink=fled green=working gray=downed". The raider dot is gone from the drawn frame, not merely undocumented.

frames.cropNote: Same crop rectangle as evidence/210-before.json, on the same 1280x720 frame: the battle knot of nine bodies at the west wall. Full frames are 235626 and 239852 bytes; cropped and reduced to a 128-color palette they are 32120 and 32166 bytes, so only the cropped PNGs are committed.
frames.whatChanges: Legend panel (right-side HUD column, outside this crop) gains the row naming the five state-dot colors between before and after; the raider dot (present in every prior PR back to commit 2c948a3) is no longer drawn in the after frame.

pixelDiff.method: PIL.ImageChops.difference on the two full, uncropped 1280x720 PNGs (before quantization), thresholded at per-pixel channel sum > 10

worldSpaceCluster.identity: the removed raider dot -- a 14x13px cluster, consistent with a 2px-radius circle at 2x camera zoom plus anti-aliasing

pixelDiff.conclusion: Exactly two disjoint diff regions exist between before.png and after.png: the legend text and one small world-space cluster at the raider's position. Nothing else in the frame changed.

raiderDotCloseUp.cropNote: The world-space diff cluster above, cropped tight and scaled 4x nearest-neighbor so the removed dot is unambiguous rather than a few pixels lost in a wide shot. The lighter, larger pink blob in both images is the goblin's mouth (sprite art, unrelated); the smaller, more saturated pink circle sitting on the tusk in 'before' is the removed marker.

raiderMarkerDecision.what: DrawRaiderInformation drew a constant #fecaca dot at the raider's upper-right corner for every non-Downed RaiderMode. Its color never varied with RaiderMode -- it was always the same pale pink -- so it carried no information the already-legended red outline does not give.
raiderMarkerDecision.decision: Removed the marker rather than adding a legend row for it. A row would have documented a color that means nothing.
raiderMarkerDecision.observedBefore: 1 match: DrawCircle(center + ScaleWorld(6, -6), ScaleWorld(2), new Color("#fecaca"));

defectFoundDuringImplementation.where: Main.CreateLegend, discovered while capturing the after frame above
defectFoundDuringImplementation.what: Growing the legend from 8 to 9 rows (round 1's state-dot row, unchanged) overflows AssertLabelsFit's worst-case feed measurement at viewport (2048, 1440), UI scale 2, on this exact scene
defectFoundDuringImplementation.firstEngineError: The HUD loses text in 1 place(s): the story of 'widest padded story' needs 10 lines but only 9 fit at viewport (2048, 1440), UI scale 2.
reproducedOn: 8e41cf3 (round 1's own branch tip, before this branch's rebase)
defectFoundDuringImplementation.conclusion: Not a rebase side effect -- present since round 1's own commit, undetected because dotnet test does not run the Godot engine and AssertLabelsFit only runs inside it
defectFoundDuringImplementation.fix: Folded the standalone "LEGEND" heading row into the shortest content row ("amber X = dig mark / yellow bar = dig progress"), returning the legend to 8 rows total while keeping every word both rows had
defectFoundDuringImplementation.afterFix: engineErrorCount 0 on the same scene, same viewport sweep (see after.result above)
defectFoundDuringImplementation.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run-game.ps1 -GodotPath <godot-console> -Fixture prepared -ScreenshotTicks 1318 -ScreenshotPath "222/probe.png" -TileSize 40 -CameraZoom 2.0 -CameraPosition "1020,480" -UiScale 1.0 -FrameSize "1280x720" -TemporaryRoot <short dir outside the worktree>

legendFit.label: legend[0]
legendFit.text: LEGEND — amber X = dig mark / yellow bar = dig progress
legendFit.note: The merged heading row measured at 1 needed / 1 visible line at width 367 (the same column width evidence/208-side-indicator.json measured legend[1] against) across every checked viewport, including the (2048, 1440) UI-scale-2 case that failed before the fix.
